svg.title: Sleeper GM
svg.desc: The app favicon AND the badge in the header. A favicon cannot read CSS custom properties, so the four colors below are literal copies of the surface, line, accent and bg tokens in web/src/styles.css. Keep them in sync if those tokens ever move. (Note for editors: XML forbids a double hyphen inside a comment, which is why this note is a desc element and the token names are written without their leading dashes.)
